items.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا
items.r: أخرجه أبو داود 4/ 326 وابن ماجة 2/ 1228 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجة 2/ 305
items.en: O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness and I take refuge with You from it’s evil.
items.tl: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayrahā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā

items.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ
items.en: O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness, the good within it, and the good it was sent with, and I take refuge with You from it’s evil, the evil within it, and from the evil it was sent with.
items.tl: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayrahā, wa khayra mā fīhā, wa khayra mā ursilat bihi, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā, washarri mā fīhā, washarri mā ursilat bih
